research_notes: The strict protocol's fixed +3m planned gap is an experimental control, not a claim that three minutes is optimal.
Earlier relay evidence may suggest smaller gaps are possible, but changing it now would mix variables.
After runtime cap validation, gap optimization can test 3m, 2m, 1m under otherwise fixed conditions.
Actual idle gap and overlap risk will determine the preferred value.
The eventual parallel research may intentionally exploit overlap, but only after scheduler/authority fencing is established.
Current sample retains the baseline gap.
